gherkin.scenario: Add a renewal period to a leave right
given: I am logged in as a user
when: I click the View button for the "test" right
I click the Add button in the Renewals section
I fill in the Start field with "5/13/26"
I fill in the Finish field with "5/19/26"
then: The message "The right renewal period has been created" should appear on the screen

gherkin_acceptance_criteria: The message "The right renewal period has been created" should appear on the screen
